findings.title: Unsafe dynamic query construction
findings.issue: The handler builds a CQN query using string concatenation with user input, bypassing parameter binding and allowing malformed input to alter the query.
findings.recommendation: Use parameterized CQN: const rows = await SELECT.from(Books).where({ ID: req.data.ID });
findings.codeSnippet: const rows = await cds.run(`SELECT * FROM Books WHERE ID = '${req.data.ID}'`);

findings.title: Service exposed without authorization
findings.issue: AdminService has no @requires or @restrict annotation. It is reachable by any authenticated user, and possibly by anonymous callers depending on approuter config.
findings.recommendation: Add @(requires: 'Admin') at the service level and @restrict per entity as needed.

findings.title: Unbounded OData read
findings.issue: The list binding reads all rows without $top; on large tables this loads the whole dataset into the client.
findings.recommendation: Add growingThreshold on sap.m.Table or set $top on the binding parameters.

findings.title: Deprecated jQuery.sap.log usage
findings.issue: jQuery.sap.log is deprecated since UI5 1.58; using it prevents future upgrade and warns in newer runtimes.
findings.recommendation:
Replace with sap/base/Log:
  sap.ui.define(['sap/base/Log'], function(Log) { Log.info('...'); });

findings.title: No unit or OPA tests found
findings.issue: The project contains no test/ folder or *.qunit.html; regressions cannot be caught automatically.
findings.recommendation: Add QUnit tests for controllers and OPA5 journeys for critical user flows.

summary.assessment: Blockers present — resolve authorization + injection issues before merge
